# Dun Morrach: Side-Activity Menu (SEALED — DM ONLY)

> **Dun Morrach** (aka Dun Morak, Dunmorrach). The dwarven hold of about 15,000 under the Kettlehorns, below Bearback Pass.
> **Government:** a **dwarven king under the mountain.** **King Torvald Deepanvil** (NPC-066) rules from the Anvil Throne. Kingship is hereditary but must be **re-struck** every ten years: the clan heads can refuse to swear again (next Re-Striking: Deepwinter YF 1106). His heir is his granddaughter **Princess Brynja** (NPC-067), warrior and engineer; an older-sister ally to Gideon, no romance. **Law:** the **Hearth Guard**. Outsiders need a **guest-token** to go deeper than the Front Gate halls.
> **When visited:** Ch10 (the oath broken, EVT-17; `chapters/act2/ch10.md` side window has the Anvil Test, the Kettle Plunge, the Shield Ring and a clan heirloom) and Ch17 (the alliance; T4). **Tier: T2 and T4.**
> **DM notes (world/03):** SEC-11. The dwarves stopped mining glimmer 400 years ago after the Gate War, when their mining cracked the Deep Spring Wellgate and the Mountain Bear (Ursk) died closing it. The **Oath of the Quiet Stone**. Torvald breaks it only for a Hearkener or the Bear's chosen (Gideon). The **Sealed Deep** holds the Deep Spring. **No glimmer anywhere in the hold.** Anyone carrying it is asked, politely, to leave it at the Front Gate.

---

## 1. The hold at a glance

- **Look:** warm stone halls carved like the inside of a great bell; forge-glow from below; hot-spring steam drifting through carved vents; stone lamps burning oil (never glimmer); statues of bears everywhere, one in every hall, worn smooth by hands.
- **Sound:** hammers, echoing song (dwarves sing while they work, in parts), water.
- **Feel:** formal, proud, and very funny once they trust you. A dwarf never forgets a debt or an insult; both are carved somewhere.
- **Districts:** **the Front Gate** (trade halls open to outsiders), **the Deep Forges**, **the King's Hall**, **the Hot Kettles** (hot-spring bathhouses), **the Undermarket**, **the Sealed Deep** (forbidden).
- **Guest-tokens:** a carved stone disc. **Ch10:** the Kettle Plunge wins one. Other ways: a dwarf vouching (Brynja), a service to a clan, or the King's word. Without one, the party stays in the Front Gate halls.

---

## 2. Shops and services

**No haggling in the hold.** Prices are carved on a slate by the door. Insisting on haggling is an insult (the shop closes to you for the day). **But:** Ash speaks Dwarvish. Any shopkeeper addressed in good Dwarvish (**Charisma (Persuasion) DC 12**, or no roll if he's polite) takes 5% off "for the courtesy," and it's the only discount anyone ever gets.

### 2.1 Stonemantle's (the Front Gate)
**Keeper: Gudrun Stonemantle** (NPC-341; aka Gudrin, Stonemantel), master armorer, iron-grey braids pinned with bear-claw clasps, who tests every piece by hitting the buyer while they wear it.
**Interior (painter):** a vaulted hall lit by a forge pit in the floor; armor on stone forms like a silent army; a bear statue wearing a helmet; a slate of prices carved in runes and, below them, in Common, as an afterthought.
| Item | Rarity | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dwarven-made mundane arms and armor | mundane | PHB ×1.5 | Beautiful; −1 lb weight; never rust |
| **Mithral Armor** (any medium or heavy) | Uncommon | 400 + base | |
| **Adamantine Armor** | Uncommon | 400 + base | |
| **Armor +1** | Rare | 4,000 + base | T2: on request (two weeks). T4: in stock |
| **Shield +2** · **Weapon +2** (axes, hammers, picks, short blades) | Rare | 4,000 + base | T4 |
| **Dwarven Plate** | Very Rare | 40,000 + base | T4, Ch17 only, and only for Gideon (Gudrun calls him "the Bear's boy" from Ch10 on) |
| **Dwarven Thrower** | Very Rare | 40,000 + base | T4. Only for a dwarf, or for someone a dwarf king names friend. |
**Every item here is true magic. None of it has glimmer. All of it survives every ending.**

### 2.2 The Undermarket (deep halls; guest-token needed)
A cavern market of stalls under hanging lamps: gems, iron, gnome-trade clockwork, dwarven ale, mushroom bread. **Notable stalls:**
- **Gems and art objects** at full value: the place to sell treasure gems (**the only place in the north that pays full price**, 100%).
- **Dwarven ale** (a cask 10 gp; a mug 4 cp): Constitution saves to stay upright (**DC 12 per three mugs**).
- **Potion of Fire Breath, Potion of Hill Giant Strength** (Uncommon consumable, 200 gp each), **Elixir of Health** (Rare consumable, 2,000 gp; T4).
- **Brynja's workshop** (by invitation): siege engines, mining tools, a half-built war-wagon. She'll build the party one thing (Ch10 onward), any Common or Uncommon tool-type item, **free**, for Gideon.

### 2.3 The Hot Kettles (bathhouses)
A cavern of hot pools stepping down the rock, each hotter than the last. A soak: 2 cp. **The Kettle Plunge** contest (§3). Rest here counts as a **long rest with advantage** on the next day's first Constitution save (it's that good).

## 3. Festivals and contests

| Contest | When | Chain | Prize |
|---|---|---|---|
| **The Anvil Test** | every year on 21 Deepwinter (the **Re-Striking Eve** every tenth year; next YF 1106) and any day at a forge-master's whim | Ch10: **Strength (Athletics) DC 16** + smith's tools or Dex DC 14. Full version: three links, **Athletics DC 16** (lift the hammer) · **Smith's Tools or Con DC 15** (keep the rhythm for a hundred strokes) · **Wisdom DC 14** (hear when the iron's right) | A dwarven-forged dagger (mundane, beautiful); on the Eve, the King shakes your hand |
| **The Kettle Plunge** | season opens with the first snow of Frostcome; any day after | Ch10: **Con DC 13, 15, 17, 19** in hotter pools; last one standing | A **guest-token**; bragging; Bart can't enter and sulks on a warm rock |
| **The drinking contest** | any night at the Front Gate's long tables | **Con DC 12, 14, 16, 18 …** last standing (Moss can't get drunk) | The pot; a dwarf will call you "kin" until morning |
| **The Bear-Song** | 21 Deepwinter | A singing contest in parts; **Charisma (Performance) DC 15** as a group (all four may sing). Ash's tune, sung here, makes the bear statues **hum** (Ch10 SEC-11 territory; only if the chapter has broken the oath, otherwise the dwarves go white and stop the song) | The King's thanks; after Ch10, the hold sings Ash's tune back to him |

### Skill contests (`00-index.md` §11; CHG-21)
- **The Kettle Steps** (Gauntlet, Hard, T2 / T4): up the steaming spring-terraces under the mountain: slick stone ⬇ (Dex save), the heat ⏱ (**Con save**, three stations of it: the dwarves' strength and Ash's weakness), the steam-jets ⏱ (Perception to time them), the last terrace ⬇ (Athletics). **Entry 10 gp** (T2) / 200 gp (T4). Dwarves (+8 Con saves, −2 Acrobatics) usually pass; outsiders usually don't, and the dwarves respect anyone who tries twice.
- **The Dwarven Lock-Box** (lock-picking, **Brutal**, T2 / T4): five dwarven locks, DC **16 / 17 / 18 / 19 / 21**, two trapped (a needle and a crushing bar: Dex save DC 15 or 2d6 bludgeoning). **No fee, no pot: the prize is a dwarven pick set** (+2 to Thieves' Tools checks, non-magical) **and respect**: the clan's attitude to the party improves one step for whoever opens all five. No outsider has in nine years. (Betting on yourself here is dishonorable, `§4`.)

### New contests (`00-index.md` §12; CHG-22)
- **Strange Arms exhibition: the Kettle-sling** on the spring terraces. No purse; the prize is a dwarven nod, which is worth more here. The dwarves watch the Hidden Trick (the skip) very closely.


## 4. The Shield Ring (formal honor bouts)

**Ring formats (`00-index.md` §5.1, CHG-19):** the Shield Ring is formal **Touches** with shields allowed (+2 ring AC for a shield-bearer; dwarves love it). An outsider may choose **Ring-Out on the Anvil Bridge** instead; the dwarves think that's undignified and come to watch anyway. No magic in any format: no smites, no spells, no Wild Shape, no familiars. Dexterity fighters can win here.

A round hall with a floor of polished granite and a ring of shields hung on the wall, one for every champion. Bouts are formal, **blunted** weapons, and **honor-scored**: a fighter who uses a dirty trick (a trip, a feint, Cunning Strikes count) wins nothing even if they win the bout. **Exception:** a trick *announced* beforehand is honorable ("I will feint low"). Ash can announce his Cunning Strikes. The dwarves find this hilarious and correct.
- **No betting on yourself** (dishonorable; `00-index.md` §4).
- **Win a bout and dwarves respect you** (Ch10: SC 10-B link 1 automatic).

### BERSI FLINTFIST (the proud young champion)
*Medium Humanoid (dwarf), Lawful Neutral*
**AC** 18 (plate in the Ring: chain and shield) · **Initiative** +1 (11) · **HP** 65 (T2, Ch10's numbers) · 140 (T4)
**Speed** 25 ft.

|   | Score | Mod | Save |   | Score | Mod | Save |   | Score | Mod | Save |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| STR | 18 | +4 | +7 | DEX | 12 | +1 | +1 | CON | 18 | +4 | +7 |
| INT | 11 | +0 | +0 | WIS | 13 | +1 | +4 | CHA | 12 | +1 | +1 |

**Skills** Athletics +7, Intimidation +4 · **Resistances** poison · **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11 · **Languages** Common, Dwarvish · **CR** 5 (T2) / 12 (T4)
*Tuned for: T2 party level 10 (Gideon alone: ring DPR ~20 with +25% HP per `00-index` §5.2): solo guard-champion; Ch10 gives him "Hearth Guard numbers: AC 18, 65 HP, +7 warhammer 1d8+4". T4 (Ch17 rematch): +2 AC, +4 to hit, damage 2d8+6, Multiattack 3, HP 140.* NPC-340; Torvald's grand-nephew, proud, fair, stiff, and desperate for a worthy opponent.

**Traits**
- ***Honor-Bound.*** If an opponent uses an unannounced trick, Bersi gains advantage on his next attack (he's furious) and the bout's honor goes to him.
- ***Dwarven Resilience.*** Advantage on saves against being poisoned.
- ***Round-2 Turn: "Shield to the Bear."*** At the start of round 2, Bersi touches his shield to the hall's bear statue: **+2 AC** until he next takes damage.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** Two Warhammer strikes (three at T4).
- ***Blunted Warhammer.*** *Melee:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning, nonlethal. (T4: +11, 2d8 + 6.)
- ***Shield Bash (bonus action).*** One creature within 5 ft: **DC 15 Str save** or pushed 5 ft (T4: DC 19, and prone).

**Tactics:** stands like a door. Waits for the opponent to come. If Gideon beats him honorably, Bersi kneels and asks to carry Gideon's shield in the alliance (Ch17).

---

## 5. Street fights

**Never in the hold.** A brawl is an insult to the hall it happens in. The Hearth Guard arrive in round 1 and everyone involved spends a night in the **Quiet Room** (a cell with no echo; dwarves find it terrifying). At the Front Gate's long tables, though, a drunken "wrestle for the last mug" is tradition (best of three opposed Athletics, no damage).

---

## 6. Betting

Only on honor bouts, in **carved tokens** (each worth 5 gp to the dwarf who carved it, more to a collector). Never on yourself.

---

## 7. Odd jobs

`world/03` and Ch10 list: clear a flooded mine level, escort a caravan through the pass, recover a clan heirloom (Ch10: the oath-ring pawned at Wolfsgate).
| d6 | Job | Pay | Quick run |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Clear a flooded mine level (something's living in it) | 150 gp (T2) / 600 gp (T4) | An ordinary fight in water (Giant Crabs, or a Hushed cave bear from a thin place: wake it, DC 17 / 21) |
| 2 | Escort a caravan through Bearback Pass | 100 gp | Snow and wolves (Wolfsgate job 1); after Ch10, the pass is safe and it's a pleasant walk with songs |
| 3 | Carry a message to the Hobbland gnomes | 50 gp | Pernella Gearspring sends back a crate of springs (`07-bramblecog.md`) |
| 4 | Help Brynja test a war-wagon | 40 gp | Dex DC 15 ×2 to keep it on the track; Strength DC 16 to stop it at the end. It goes into the river. Brynja is delighted. |
| 5 | Find a lost apprentice in the Deep Forges' old tunnels | 75 gp | Survival DC 15 underground; she's found an old warning-stone (SEC-11 color) |
| 6 | (T4) Bring word to the clan heads for the Ch17 muster | the King's gratitude | A Persuasion chain, DC 18 / 20 / 22, for each stubborn clan |

---

## 8. Things worth stealing

**Nothing without grave insult.** A theft from a dwarf is carved on a wall forever.
**Retrieving stolen dwarven heirlooms is gold:** any heirloom recovered and returned earns **150 gp × tier**, a clan's friendship, and the clan's name for the returner ("Ash Oathring-Bringer," for instance; the dwarves pick it).
**Fence:** none. "Fence? We have *walls*."

---

## 9. Rivals

- **Bersi Flintfist** (NPC-340), the proud young champion who challenges Gideon (§4).
- **Clan Coalbeard's elders**, who are ashamed of Dagny (`02-enchanters-row.md` §3.7). After Ch10, if the party carries her story here, the elders send her a letter. That letter is the beat. (No mechanics.)
